name: Casting Discordance unleashes Crystal Cannon (#1034)
contract: Crystal Cannon 806204 applies aura 42 (proc trigger spell) on Crystal Cannon 704481 (the repeating wand-attack channel), but Spell.dbc gives it ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so it never procced. With a spell_proc row gated on the magic class damage of Discordance (100% chance), a single Discordance hit should apply the Crystal Cannon channel (704481) to the target.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
No Crystal Cannon channel before any cast
Discordance's hit unleashes the Crystal Cannon channel
